Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine and run around with her friends. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to put on her uniform so she wouldn't be messy. 

Lily tried and tried, but she couldn't do it right. She felt very sad. Her mommy asked her why she didn't just smile at her for a uniform, but Lily didn't listen. She just wanted to keep playing. 

Later that day, Lily's uniform got dirty and she had to wear it. She didn't like it because it was dirty
